# Web3 Today

> Web3 Today reports crypto news with technical precision: protocol upgrades, client releases, consensus changes and the parameters behind them.

## Key pages
- [Homepage](https://cryptonsu.github.io/): latest reporting and analysis.
- [About](https://cryptonsu.github.io/about/): editorial scope, independence, sourcing and corrections.
- [Archive](https://cryptonsu.github.io/archive/): everything published.
